shortDescription: German copper producer Aurubis XETR:NDA on Tuesday forecast operating earnings before taxes of €430 million to €530 million ($469 million to $578 million) for its 2026/27 financial year, below market expectations, as technical problems delay the ramp-up of its new US recycling plant.Aurubis said it…

children: on Tuesday forecast operating earnings before taxes of €430 million to €530 million ($469 million to $578 million) for its 2026/27 financial year, below market expectations, as technical problems delay the ramp-up of its new US recycling plant.

Aurubis said it had identified the need to modify parts of the suspension system for smelting furnaces at its plant in Richmond County, Georgia, and that the work was expected to take around six months.
Aurubis now expects the plant's technical ramp-up to be achieved in the second half of 2028
The forecast for 2026/27 operating EBT is below a company-compiled consensus of €564 million
Preliminary 2025/26 operating EBT rose to €516 million from €355 million a year earlier, also missing consensus of €525 million
Aurubis shares were down 10.7% as of 0952 GMT
